Instancing - Voxel Tools documentation
Instancing The module provides an instancing system with the VoxelInstancer node. This node must be added as child of a voxel terrain. It supports spawning 3D models on top of the terrain's surface, which can later be removed when modified. It can spawn two different kinds of objects: Multimesh instances.
